items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: his brother had a boy by the name of Doc, well I had him alternate until I got Raymond.

ctx.x: You know he went to- Joe Robichaud or what's Joe?

Joe Robichaud. He was playing at Durbin and Jackson at that time. And then after the city death, we wind up taking Gordette with him, you know, the daddy, and then this boy Gordette had a son, his brother had a boy by the name of Doc, well I had him alternate until I got Raymond. Raymond started playing with this band there, went there with the Natchez fire. Walter Bach. Yeah, well Raymond's wife, first wife, or one of his wives, the seven that got burnt up in that fire. But he didn't get burned. No, Raymond…
